title: Walter Pichon's band behind Mamie Smith
summary: Leaves Handy for Pichon's band backing Mamie Smith on vaudeville shows; lists the sidemen.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Then I left Hande's band, I went with Walter Pichon's band, and we played for Mamie Smith on the Vaudeville shows.
What was the blues singer? Blue singer. Who was on that band with drumming?
In that band, Thedo Poinel was on sax, George Clark was on sax, and Botley again was on sax, Edward Botley. Chester Zardes on bass.

Chester Zardes on bass. Stanley Williams on drum. Bigfoot Bill was on drum. And Pichon was on the piano. I was playing the band, and Clifford Brown on trumpet, Gordette was on trumpet. That's Clifford Brown. Oh yes. And we had a boy from out of town playing trombone. Can't remember his name. That was?
Yeah, he could play a lot of trombone.
I think his last name was Meredith.
Yeah. And that was with Mamie Smith. About what year? Can you figure out if it was during the depression?
